title: private-deployment-lyra-weekly-sync-2026-09-14
body:
Project Lyra  Weekly sync notes (prep + follow-ups) 2026-09-14

Owners / attendees (expected):
- Ava Patel (owner, REDWOOD PM)
- Marcus Chen (SRE lead)
- Diego Rivera (Infra eng, customer onsite lead)
- Samir Kapadia (security / compliance)
- Elena Novak (Customer: Acme Health, technical lead)
- Optional: Jordan (customer network) if available

Goal for this sync:
- Quick status on remaining VPC peering / firewall rules and on-prem rack readiness
- Surface any blockers that risk the 2026-09-30 staging cutover
- Confirm owners and immediate next steps (this weekly should produce discrete action items)

Agenda:
1) Quick round robin updates (5m)
2) VPC / network (10m)  - Marcus + Jordan if present
   - Transit gateway peering, IP ranges, egress rules
3) On-prem hardware + rack readiness (10m)  - Diego
   - NVIDIA node firmware, switch configs, cabling status
4) Key management & HSM integration (5m)  - Samir
5) Deployment plan for staging cutover (10m)  - Ava + Elena
6) Blockers & risks (10m)
7) Action items & owners (5m)

Notes to prep / FYI (for meeting):
- Customer requested strict outbound egress restrictions; we need explicit list of endpoints to allow. Elena, please confirm the final list by 2026-09-16 (see JIRA-LYRA-117).
- Confluence page LYRA-arch-design updated with the new peering diagram 2026-09-12; Marcus please double-check subnet maps before the sync.
- PR #58 applies a change to bootstrap scripts for on-prem nodes (disk partitioning + nvme firmware check). Diego to confirm whether PR is safe to merge to staging this week.

Current status summary (short):
- Network: Transit gateway peering requested, cloud infra team created peering but customer routing still pending (Jordan to confirm).
- On-prem: 4/6 racks staged; 2 racks pending NIC firmware update and 10G cabling confirmation.
- Secrets/KMS: HSM test vector successful in dev env; integration test failed for key rotation policy (see JIRA-LYRA-101).
- Infra automation: bootstrap PRs in review, one flaky test failing in CI (investigating).

Open blockers (priority order):
1) Routing overlap between customer on-prem subnets and our management VPC  - Owner: Marcus Chen. Impact: high (stops cutover). Target: resolution by 2026-09-16.
2) NIC firmware mismatch on 2 on-prem racks (nodes failing health checks). Owner: Diego Rivera. Impact: medium-high (reduces capacity). Target: firmware patch + reboot by 2026-09-17.
3) Key rotation test failing under HSM policy (integration test). Owner: Samir Kapadia. Impact: medium (security gating). Target: workaround and retest by 2026-09-18.
4) Customer firewall requires explicit hostnames for TLS egress rather than IPs; needs sign-off from security and product on acceptable TLS destinations. Owner: Elena Novak + Samir. Impact: medium. Target: decision by 2026-09-16.

Risks to escalate to ENG leadership if not closed this week:
- If peering not resolved by 2026-09-16, we should delay staging cutover; notify customer and leadership.
- If NIC firmware issues persist beyond 2026-09-17, capacity on go-live will be under our SLA commitment for Dedicated customers.

Action items (explicit):
- Marcus: Coordinate with Jordan + cloud infra to reassign non-overlapping subnets and post updated route table by 2026-09-16. Linked: JIRA-LYRA-117.
- Diego: Apply NIC firmware patch to two affected racks, run health checks, and post results to thread by 2026-09-17. PR #58 needs verification before merge.
- Samir: Investigate HSM rotation failure, produce a short runbook for temporary rotation workaround, and retest by 2026-09-18. Attach logs to JIRA-LYRA-101.
- Elena (customer): Provide final list of allowed egress hostnames/IPs for firewall rules by 2026-09-16. If they insist on hostnames only, confirm TLS dest list.
- Ava: Prepare contingency message for customer + leadership (if peering slips) and draft updated cutover timeline. Due 2026-09-16 noon PT.
- All: Update the Confluence runbook LYRA-arch-design with latest CIDR allocations and bootstrapping steps after changes merge (tag PRs in page).

Parking lot / items to take offline:
- Detailed circuit ordering timelines (Jordan + customer network vendor)  - coordinate outside this weekly.
- Post-cutover performance tests and SLO validation plan  - will schedule separate perf runbook session next week.

Notes to self / scratchpad (informal):
- Remember to ask Elena about their on-call rotation for the cutover weekend (need 24/7 fallback contact).
- Double-check billing account/account IDs for VPC peering API calls  - previous peering failed due to wrong account tag (saw this in cloud logs last week).

Meeting prep checklist (for me):
- Pull updated route tables and attach to Confluence (done? verify).
- Confirm PR #58 status and leave comment if we can merge after Diego verifies.
- Draft contingency email (template saved in /templates/customer-cutover-delay.md).

Next sync: 2026-09-21 (same time).

-- end of notes --
